CancelUpdateStack.description_en: Cancels an update operation on a stack. You can call this operation to cancel an update operation on a stack when the stack is being updated or created
CancelUpdateStack.description_zh: 当您的资源栈正处于更新中或创建中且操作尚未完成，您可以调用该接口取消更新资源栈操作

ContinueCreateStack.description_en: Continues to create a stack after the stack fails to be created
ContinueCreateStack.description_zh: 资源栈创建失败后，继续创建资源栈

CreateAITask.description_zh: 创建AI任务以执行特定的自动化工作流，如生成、修复模板或部署资源栈

CreateChangeSet.description_en: Creates a change set for a stack so you can preview changes before execution
CreateChangeSet.description_zh: 为资源栈创建更改集，您可以在执行更改之前查看对应更改内容

CreateDiagnostic.description_zh: 创建诊断任务进行一键诊断

CreateStack.description_en: Creates a stack from a ROS template to deploy a group of resources
CreateStack.description_zh: 使用资源编排模板创建资源栈，完成一组资源的创建

CreateStackGroup.description_en: Creates a stack group from an ROS template to create stacks across multiple Alibaba Cloud accounts and regions
CreateStackGroup.description_zh: 使用资源编排模板创建资源栈组，通过资源栈组，可以在多个阿里云账号中跨地域创建资源栈

CreateStackInstances.description_en: Creates stack instances for one or more accounts in the specified regions
CreateStackInstances.description_zh: 为一个或多个账号在指定地域下创建资源栈实例

DeleteChangeSet.description_zh: 为已创建更改集的资源栈删除更改集

DeleteStack.description_en: Deletes a stack, optionally retaining resources
DeleteStack.description_zh: 删除指定资源栈，可以选择是否保留资源

DeleteStackGroup.description_zh: 删除已创建的资源栈组

DeleteStackInstances.description_en: Deletes stack instances from specified accounts and regions. You can choose to retain the resources
DeleteStackInstances.description_zh: 为一个或多个账号在指定地域下删除资源栈实例，可以选择是否保留资源

DeleteTemplate.description_zh: 删除指定模板，如果已将模板共享给其他阿里云账号，需要取消共享后才能删除

DeregisterResourceType.description_en: Deletes a resource type or a specific version of a resource type
DeregisterResourceType.description_zh: 删除资源类型，或删除已有资源类型的某个版本

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries a list of available regions

DetectStackDrift.description_en: Performs drift detection on resources in a stack to check whether the resources have drifted from the expected template configurations
DetectStackDrift.description_zh: 对资源栈进行偏差检测，可以限定具体资源，以便确定资源栈是否已偏离其预期的模板配置

DetectStackGroupDrift.description_en: Performs drift detection on stack groups to check whether the stack groups have drifted from the expected template configurations
DetectStackGroupDrift.description_zh: 对资源栈组进行偏差检测，以便确定资源栈组是否已偏离其预期的模板配置

DetectStackResourceDrift.description_en: Performs drift detection on resources in a stack to determine whether the resources have drifted from the expected configurations
DetectStackResourceDrift.description_zh: 对资源进行偏差检测，以便确定资源是否已偏离其预期的模板配置

ExecuteChangeSet.description_zh: 对资源栈执行更改集，资源变更即可生效

GenerateTemplateByScratch.description_en: Generates a template for a resource scenario

GenerateTemplatePolicy.description_en: Generates the policy information required by a specified template
GenerateTemplatePolicy.description_zh: 通过指定模板生成模板所需的策略信息

GetAITask.description_en: Queries the information about an AI task by task ID
GetAITask.description_zh: 指定AI任务ID，获取AI任务的详细信息

GetChangeSet.description_en: Returns details for a specified change set, optionally including the details of its associated template
GetChangeSet.description_zh: 查询指定更改集信息，可以选择是否获取对应模板详情

GetDiagnostic.description_en: Obtains the diagnosis details based on a specified diagnostic report ID
GetDiagnostic.description_zh: 指定诊断报告ID，获取诊断的详细信息

GetFeatureDetails.description_en: Queries the details of features that are supported by Resource Orchestration Service (ROS)
GetFeatureDetails.description_zh: 查询ROS支持的特定功能详情

GetResourceType.description_en: Queries the details of a resource type
GetResourceType.description_zh: 通过指定资源类型查询详细信息

GetResourceTypeTemplate.description_en: Generates a sample template based on a resource type
GetResourceTypeTemplate.description_zh: 根据资源类型生成一个示例模板

GetServiceAccess.description_en: Queries the access status of a trusted service

GetServiceProvisions.description_en: Queries the activation status of an Alibaba Cloud service and information about its service-linked roles
GetServiceProvisions.description_zh: 查询服务开通状态和服务角色信息

GetStackDriftDetectionStatus.description_en: Queries the drift detection status of a stack
GetStackDriftDetectionStatus.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下根据偏差检测ID查询偏差检查状态

GetStackGroup.description_en: Queries the details of a stack group by its name in an Alibaba Cloud region
GetStackGroup.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下根据资源栈组名称查询资源栈组详情

GetStackGroupOperation.description_en: Queries the information about a stack group operation in an Alibaba Cloud region
GetStackGroupOperation.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询指定资源栈组的操作详情

GetStackInstance.description_en: Queries the information about a stack instance that is associated with a stack group
GetStackInstance.description_zh: 查询指定资源栈组关联的资源栈实例详情

GetStackPolicy.description_en: Queries the stack policy of a specified stack
GetStackPolicy.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询指定资源栈策略详情

GetStackResource.description_en: Query a resource in a specific stack
GetStackResource.description_zh: 查询某个资源栈的资源

GetTemplate.description_en: Queries the details of a template based on stacks, stack groups, change sets, or any custom template information
GetTemplate.description_zh: 指定资源栈、资源栈组、更改集、自定义模板其中任意信息获取模板详情

GetTemplateEstimateCost.description_en: Queries the estimated prices of the resources in a template
GetTemplateEstimateCost.description_zh: 通过指定模板和模板参数查询创建资源栈的预估价格

GetTemplateParameterConstraints.description_en: Queries the valid values of the parameters in a template

GetTemplateScratch.description_en: Retrieves the details of a resource scenario

GetTemplateSummary.description_en: Queries the information about a template resource by using the relevant template, stack, stack group, or change set
GetTemplateSummary.description_zh: 通过指定模板、资源栈、资源栈组、更改集其中任意信息查询模板资源详情

ImportStacksToStackGroup.description_en: Import stacks from multiple different accounts into a stack group
ImportStacksToStackGroup.description_zh: 将多个不同账号下的资源栈导入至资源栈组

ListAITaskEvents.description_en: Queries the events of an AI task

ListAITasks.description_en: Queries a list of AI tasks

ListChangeSets.description_en: Queries the details of created change sets
ListChangeSets.description_zh: 查询已创建的更改集列表详情

ListChatMessages.description_en: Retrieves the message history and temporary download URLs for Pipeline snapshots of a specified session by session ID
ListChatMessages.description_zh: 通过会话ID获取指定会话的消息历史和Pipeline快照临时下载地址

ListChatSessions.description_en: Queries the ROS Agent V2 session list for the current user by using paging
ListChatSessions.description_zh: 分页查询当前用户的ROS Agent V2会话列表

ListResourceTypeRegistrations.description_en: Queries a list of resource registration records
ListResourceTypeRegistrations.description_zh: 查询资源注册记录列表

ListResourceTypeVersions.description_en: Queries the list of resource type versions, including resource types created by the user and those provided by Resource Orchestration Service (ROS)
ListResourceTypeVersions.description_zh: 查询资源类型版本列表，包括用户自己创建的和ROS提供的资源类型

ListResourceTypes.description_en: Queries the list of supported resource types
ListResourceTypes.description_zh: 查询支持的资源类型列表

ListStackEvents.description_en: Queries events of a stack and the resources in the stack
ListStackEvents.description_zh: 查询资源栈及栈内资源的事件

ListStackGroupOperationResults.description_en: Queries the results of an operation on a stack group
ListStackGroupOperationResults.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询指定资源栈组操作的结果列表详情

ListStackGroupOperations.description_en: Queries the information about stack group operations in an Alibaba Cloud region
ListStackGroupOperations.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询资源栈组操作列表详情

ListStackGroups.description_en: Queries stack groups in a region
ListStackGroups.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询资源栈组列表详情

ListStackInstances.description_en: Queries the list of stack instances that are associated with a stack group in an Alibaba Cloud region
ListStackInstances.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询指定资源栈组关联的资源栈实例列表详情

ListStackOperationRisks.description_en: Detects stack-related operation risks and returns missing permissions and the causes of the risks
ListStackOperationRisks.description_zh: 检测进行资源栈操作可能涉及的风险，并返回风险原因或缺失项

ListStackResourceDrifts.description_en: The query token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the last API call
ListStackResourceDrifts.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询资源栈的资源偏差详情

ListStackResources.description_en: Queries the resources in a specified stack
ListStackResources.description_zh: 查询指定资源栈的资源列表

ListTagKeys.description_en: Queries the tag keys for stacks or templates in a specified region
ListTagKeys.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询资源栈或模板的标签键

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are added to resources in a template or stack in an Alibaba Cloud region
ListTagResources.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询模板或资源栈中一个或多个资源已经绑定的标签

ListTagValues.description_en: Queries the tag values that are added to resources in a template or stack in an Alibaba Cloud region
ListTagValues.description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询模板或资源栈中指定标签键对应的标签值

ListTemplateScratches.description_en: Queries a list of resource scenarios

ListTemplateVersions.description_en: Queries the list of versions of a template
ListTemplateVersions.description_zh: 通过查询指定模板获取模板的版本列表详情

ListTemplates.description_en: Queries a list of private and shared templates
ListTemplates.description_zh: 查询私有与共享的模板列表

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: Moves a resource to a specific resource group
MoveResourceGroup.description_zh: 修改资源所属的资源组

PreviewStack.description_en: Previews the information about a stack that you want to create or update based on a template. You can call this operation to verify whether the template resources are valid
PreviewStack.description_zh: 预览指定模板将要创建或更新的资源栈信息，验证模板资源的准确性

RegisterResourceType.description_en: Creates a new resource type, or creates a new version for an existing resource type
RegisterResourceType.description_zh: 创建新的资源类型，或为已有资源类型增加一个新版本

SetDeletionProtection.description_en: Modifies the deletion protection setting for a stack
SetDeletionProtection.description_zh: 修改资源栈的删除保护属性

SetResourceType.description_en: Modifies the description of a resource type or a version of that type
SetResourceType.description_zh: 修改资源类型或资源类型某个版本的相关描述

SetStackPolicy.description_en: Configures a stack policy for a stack
SetStackPolicy.description_zh: 为指定资源栈配置资源策略

SetTemplatePermission.description_zh: 为指定模板设置共享或取消共享

SignalResource.description_en: Sends a signal to a resource in a stack
SignalResource.description_zh: 您可以调用本接口对指定资源栈的资源发送信号，与ALIYUN::ROS::WaitCondition配合使用以控制资源栈的执行流程

StartChat.description_en: Returns agent events through SSE streaming. Supports creating a new session or continuing an existing session
StartChat.description_zh: 通过SSE流式返回智能体事件，支持创建新会话或继续已有会话

StopChat.description_en: Stops a running task in a specified ROS Agent V2 session
StopChat.description_zh: 用于停止指定ROS Agent V2会话中正在执行的任务

StopStackGroupOperation.description_en: Stops an ongoing operation in a stack group
StopStackGroupOperation.description_zh: 停止资源栈组正在进行的操作

TagResources.description_en: Creates and adds tags to resources
TagResources.description_zh: 指定一个或多个资源创建并绑定标签

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from resources and then deletes the tags
UntagResources.description_zh: 为指定的一个或多个资源统一解绑并删除标签

UpdateStack.description_en: Updates the resource information of a created stack
UpdateStack.description_zh: 更新已创建资源栈的资源信息

UpdateStackGroup.description_zh: 更新已创建的资源栈组

UpdateStackInstances.description_en: Updates stack instances for one or more accounts in specified regions
UpdateStackInstances.description_zh: 为一个或多个账号在指定地域下更新资源栈实例

UpdateStackTemplateByResources.description_en: Eliminates stack drifts by performing drift detection
UpdateStackTemplateByResources.description_zh: 通过执行偏差检测，消除资源栈的偏差

UpdateTemplate.description_zh: 通过指定模板地址或模板详情更新模板

ValidateTemplate.description_en: Validates a template that is used to create a stack by specifying template URL or body
ValidateTemplate.description_zh: 通过指定模板地址或模板内容验证将要创建资源栈的模板
